reviews.title: Watch you hand luggage size flying from YVN
reviews.text: We’ve been sitting in the business lounge in Yerevan Zvartnots International Airport watching people boarding their flights from the floor above. All of the sudden we saw a huge congestion of people around a gate with a flight departing to Rostov, it was a flight operated by NordWind. We noticed that the gate agents were asking every passenger to put their hand luggage bag in a measuring box. Every single passenger. We were very surprised as we have never seen such a policy so strictly enforced and disorganized. What was upsetting to see is the last passenger - he was an older gentleman having one duffel bag and a duty free bag, the gate agents told him that he can only have one bag and made him so upset that he had to throw away his duty free goods in a trash can. Anyway, the airline itself looked nice on the outside, and we were curious to try flying with them, but definitely not from the Yerevan airport. Our advice is to watch your hand luggage size closely. Hope you’ll have a much more pleasant flight than that older gentleman.
reviews.author: Vera W

reviews.title: Oversell every flight and boot passengers who bought least expensive tickets
reviews.text: Three families were denied boarding. All three families paid a low fare four weeks in advance. Their seats were then sold two hours before departure for six times what we paid, so the airline took the higher fare. When I called to complain, I was told the flight was canceled. The flight was not canceled. It departed full. Disgusting business practice from a Russian airline. Their flight completion is only 22%. Don't trust them.

reviews.title: An airlines I would rate below Ryan air
reviews.text: The service with this air line was really poor the flight was delayed and the on board service was very unimpressive and our baggage was damaged coming back into Gatwick. When I filled out a damage form and when we got to the car we saw another case had been damaged however when we spoke the Norwegian air lines about it they said that they wouldn't consider it even though the rep at the airport had said to the baggage operators that there had been a number of problems. However even the one case they knew about and saw at the airport they asked for photos and other docs and then said that it would be a month before we got the paid but it still took them 3 weeks to make this decision . Since they don't sign up to any arbitration agreement I can't go to the C A A, since they wouldn't take on this matter and the cases value would be only a small amount more than the excess. When I emailed them repeated about the reason for the payment taking so long they never gave me an answer, and didn't bother to reply . I wouldn't use this company again due to the way I have been treated over a very straightforward matter. I would rate them below Ryan air !
reviews.author: Huw W

reviews.title: 20% of the flights seats didn't exist, we had to stand and wait in the cabin to be randomly assigned seats.
reviews.text: Where to begin... As the title suggests, on board this flight a number of passengers seats simply didn't exist. Presumably the plane plan on the computer differed to the layout of the plane on the tarmac so after some time the pilot says (in Russian only) to "find and take a seat" to the 20% of us left standing. Cue the stampede of passengers falling over each other to get a vacant seat. The one I found and sat in was actually assigned to a straggling passenger so most of us had to stand up once again and wait. Eventually airport staff (not the stewardess who were nowhere to be seen_ began filling up the seats similar to how they do on a rollercoaster at a theme park. By hollering "we have a 2 over here!" and "one seat here!" slowly we all were in random seats seperated from our groups. This was especially dissappointing for those who had paid for emergency exit seats and didn't receive them. The next grievance: The cabin itself was extremely hot the entire journey with no option to turn on extra air to cool. The final issue: Many people had ordered additional meals as one hot meal for a 12 hour flight provided as standard isn't enough. So I'd paid in advance for a meal, but of course the meals are assigned to seat numbers which 20% of the plane were in random seats so receiving your meal on this flight was like being in the bingo hall. "Can Elena Biriukov make herself known to crew" and "can Roman Popov make himself known to the crew" repeat x 50 Unfortunately I did not rece

You can take 15 kg as storage luggage and the standard hand luggage. You get water on board to drink, i did not order a meal. I was happy flighing with them .

reviews.title: not the best way to get from moscow to st pete
reviews.text: I couldn't resist trying out a new airline, and the price was okay. I got the cheapest ticket with just hand luggage, and the staff complained that I had a laptop bag in addition to a cabin size suitcase. I'm not gonna put my laptop in a suitcase, okay? You have to pay for a seat in order to register online, and I managed to get one without a window, grrr. (12A) I did get some amazing views over Strelna while landing. I don't recommend buying a meal for short flights like this one. The passengers who did that got their meals so late that I think they didn't finish them. Best bring your own food (or get it delivered to your gate). Sheremetyevo happens to be my least favourite Moscow airport, so I'm unlikely to fly with them again unless the destination/price is too good (Reus?). Preferably with checked luggage.
